blurb: SeaSky Cruises offers private boat and yacht charters in downtown Vancouver with licensed captains and marine liability insurance. Guests can choose from various vessels including pontoons, yachts, and large event boats for groups from 6 to 70 guests. Charters include captain, fuel, and Bluetooth speakers, with options for BBQ and catering.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to confirm booking; balance due before boarding · Deposits are non-refundable but rescheduling with notice is possible · Captain may delay, shorten, or cancel charter for weather or safety reasons with reschedule or refund · Guests must arrive early; late arrivals may shorten charter time · Outside alcohol allowed on most vessels except 85ft Event Boat · Plaza of Nations or Granville Island, depending on the vessel; exact details confirmed with booking.
